hl7.label: Basic metabolic panel
hl7.note: A routine blood chemistry panel. Potassium is flagged high, and the creatinine value 1.40 keeps its trailing zero.

hl7.label: Blood count, corrected result
hl7.note: A corrected report. Its result ids are stable, so re-sending it updates the earlier resources instead of duplicating them.

hl7.label: Blood culture, preliminary
hl7.note: Mixes value types: a SNOMED-coded organism, a structured colony count and free text.

hl7.label: Missing patient identifier
hl7.note: A result nobody can attach to a patient. The bridge refuses it instead of guessing.

hl7.label: Wrong message type (admission)
hl7.note: An ADT admission message. This bridge only handles lab results, so it says so.

hl7.label: Test traffic sent to production
hl7.note: The processing id says T for test. Test messages must never reach a production record.

hl7.label: Embedded document it can't map
hl7.note: A result that carries an embedded PDF. Dropping it silently would lose data, so the message is rejected.

hl7.label: Result dated in the year 2099
hl7.note: Well-formed HL7 that maps cleanly, then fails the validation rules because the result time is in the future.

hl7.label: Not HL7 at all
hl7.note: Plain text. It stops at the first stage.

invoice.label: Metered electricity, sub-cent price
invoice.note: 1,000 kWh at 0.0125 EUR. The price keeps its four decimals, so the line is 12.50 and not 10.00.

invoice.label: Two VAT categories
invoice.note: A standard-rate line and a zero-rate line, each with its own VAT breakdown.

invoice.label: Reverse charge
invoice.note: Reverse-charge VAT: taxed at 0% and carrying an exemption reason.

invoice.label: Shipping charge and discount
invoice.note: Document-level charge and allowance, folded into the right VAT category's taxable amount.

invoice.label: Credit note
invoice.note: Same data as an invoice, issued as a credit note (type 381).

invoice.label: Missing seller
invoice.note: No seller party. Rejected before any XML is produced.

invoice.label: Invalid VAT category
invoice.note: A VAT category code that doesn't exist.

invoice.label: Price with too many decimals
invoice.note: A unit price of 0.00001 has more decimals than the format allows. It is rejected, not silently rounded.
